Some adds also can’t be closed so you have to close the app and whatever benefit you were supposed to get from the add will not get credited. Predominantly, this is because I am unable to bank my coins at the end of each day without watching lengthy advertisements. Although it states in the app that users can opt out of watching the ads and instead, redeem their coins manually, I cannot do this as the message window does not close when prompted. Even after watching the ads, quite often there are issues which mean that my coins still aren’t banked. Until these issues are addressed, I won’t be wasting my time using the app.
